question: Which Linux companion implementation path should own the remaining work now that Windows Hub has shipped?
rationale: The remaining Linux work is a broad desktop-app product and security boundary decision, not a narrow missing code path that ClawSweeper can safely choose automatically.

options.title: Sponsor one Linux GTK path
options.body: Choose one active Linux candidate as the canonical path, define security and packaging gates, and close or redirect the other implementation track.

options.title: Split into narrower Linux follow-ups
options.body: Keep this issue as an umbrella but move app packaging, tray/status, notifications, gateway pairing, and command-approval work into smaller owner-reviewed issues or PRs.

options.title: Defer native Linux app
options.body: Keep Linux supported through CLI, Gateway, and web surfaces for now, and pause the companion-app PRs until a maintainer sponsors the product direction.

recommendation.title: Sponsor one Linux GTK path
recommendation.body: Choose one active Linux candidate as the canonical path, define security and packaging gates, and close or redirect the other implementation track.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete opened the umbrella, gave the Linux product direction in discussion, and has recent platform docs history for the app-status surface.
